purpose: Landing pages and form identities resolved against the publishers of record while direct byte access was unavailable.
howThisWasObtained: The egress gateway refuses CONNECT to every official host, and WebFetch returns EGRESS_BLOCKED for them, so no page was fetched and no PDF was downloaded. These entries come from the publishers' own search-index entries — their page titles, asset URLs and the revision strings printed in those titles.
whatThisDoesNotEstablish: the SHA-256 or byte length of anything: no byte was read
that a URL listed here currently returns 200
that a resolved PDF is free of contamination such as a flattened records-officer name
everyEntryRequires: one confirmatory download from a session permitted to reach the host, recording sha256 and byte length, before any repin.
